bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. Balance sheet is the 30-September-2024 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2023 (audited). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (the statement's own 'Ol Jan 2024 to 30 September 2024' column); 9-month PAT (770,597,440) and EPS (0.93) match EXACTLY the 9M-2024 comparative column independently printed in this bank's own 2025_Q3.json filing. The filing also prints a discrete 'Ol July to 30 September 2024' column (PBT 593,787,631; PAT 420,840,444; EPS 0.52); as with 2024_Q2.json, this discrete figure does NOT reconcile against 9-month-cumulative-minus-H1 (770,597,440-378,784,355=391,813,085 vs printed 420,840,444, a Tk.29.0m/~7% gap) -- continuing the same small cross-report inconsistency pattern found across this bank's FY2024 quarterly filings (contrast with FY2025's exact three-way reconciliation in 2025_Q1/Q2/Q3.json). THE KEY FINDING OF THIS FILE: it definitively confirms the entire FY2024 asset-quality/provisioning crisis was concentrated in Q4 2024 ALONE. Classified loans (Note 8.11, Solo) were still only Tk.5,611.34m at 30-Sep-2024 (NPL 6.52%) -- barely above Tk.5,149.57m/5.93% at 31-Dec-2023, and only modestly above Tk.5,174.08m/5.90% (Q1, per 2024_Q1.json) and Tk.5,408.97m/6.16% (Q2, per 2024_Q2.json). The loans-and-advances-only provision shortfall (Note 8.10) DECREASED FURTHER to just Tk.77.39m (from Tk.182.68m in Q2 and Tk.266.73m in Q1) -- i.e. through THREE STRAIGHT QUARTERS of FY2024 the shortfall was shrinking, not growing. Comparing this file's own figures against this bank's already-recorded FY2024 year-end figures (2024_Q4.json/sources.json: classified loans 14,332,622,928, NPL 16.17%, PAT 108,727,037) shows that Q4 2024 ALONE added Tk.8,721.29m in newly classified loans (a +155.4% single-quarter increase, taking NPL from 6.52% to 16.17%, +9.65pp) and swung PAT to an IMPLIED NET LOSS of approximately Tk.661.87m in Q4 alone (annual PAT 108.73m minus this file's 9-month cumulative PAT of 770.60m) -- i.e. Q1-Q3 2024 was a solidly profitable, asset-quality-stable period that was then overwhelmed by a single, sudden Q4 collapse, most likely surfaced by the year-end external audit. This is a materially DIFFERENT pattern from FY2025 (see 2025_Q1/Q2/Q3.json), where both the NPL ratio and the provision shortfall built up progressively across Q2-Q3 rather than appearing suddenly in Q4 -- i.e. the bank's asset-quality recognition process changed character between the two years, from a single year-end shock (FY2024) to a more gradual in-year deterioration (FY2025). This filing's own Note 8.10 footnote: 'the Bank's total provision requirement against loans and advances is Tk.382.00 crore against which Bank maintains provision of TK.346.44 crore and...letter reference no. DOS (CAMS)1157/41(dividend)/2024-1836 dated 30 April 2024, allowed deferral provision of Tk.35.56 crore upto finalization of Financial Statements for the year 2024 against which Tk.27.82 crore has been provided upto September-2024' -- confirming the Bank was on track to clear the much-smaller, already-approved FY2023 deferral by Q3, shortly before the much larger FY2024-native shortfall emerged in Q4. Capital adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosures are not part of this quarterly unaudited financial statement.
